We propose a Bidirectional Generative Cross-domain ABSA (BGCA) framework ... utilizes generative models to predict labels and generate natural sentences within a unified framework...

pre-trained generative models like BART and T5 have demonstrated impressive power in unifying various ABSA tasks without any task-specific design and external resources. By formulating each task as a sequence-to-sequence problem and producing the desired label words, i.e., the desired sentiment elements, they achieve substantial improvements on various ABSA tasks.
outputs: sentiment tuples (aspect, opinion, sentiment) and generated natural language sentences
sentiment tuples in sequence-to-sequence format with tagger tokens such as ⟨aspect⟩, ⟨opinion⟩, ⟨pos⟩, ⟨neu⟩, ⟨neg⟩
